content:
Emma: quick PRD check — I posted the draft in the doc. Need scope decision for next sprint: per-tenant retention controls + trace-sampling UI + small alerting UX polish. Can we lock scope today?
Raj: glanced through. main engineering concern is storage impact of per-tenant retention. need hard limits and quota flow.
Linda: +1 on quotas. Also need backward-compatibility for old exports. If someone sets 0d accidentally, what happens?
Omar: I can produce 2 compact mocks for the retention panel and the sampling rules modal by EOD. One inline, one modal.
Steph: data model note — sampling rules require stable rule ids for audit and dedupe, and we should surface rule hit-rate metrics.
Emma: OK actionable items: 1) quotas + errors 2) rollout plan 3) acceptance criteria. putting acceptance checklist below — please react with :thumbsup: if OK.
```text
Acceptance criteria:
- UI: per-tenant retention selector (24h,7d,30d,90d,custom in days)
- Preview: estimated storage delta and monthly cost impact shown before save
- Sampling: rule editor supports priority, percentage, conditional matcher (+ live rule preview)
- Audit: every change creates an immutable audit event with actor and timestamp
- Rollout: feature-flagged, canary 10% tenants -> 100% with rollback path
- Tests: unit + integration + small e2e for save/preview/rollback flows
```
Raj: for "estimated storage delta" — is that per-tenant historical projection or based on recent 7d average? we should define calc.
Steph: use 7d average with a note in tooltip. it's predictable enough and cheap to compute.
Linda: edgecases: tenant deletes retention and leaves traces in export queue; also cross-tenant queries during migration window must not show stale results. add acceptance bullet.
Emma: noted. adding edgecases message: accidental 0d, migration reads, export queue, admin overrides.
Omar: UX edgecase: if custom days > 365, block and show ktai warning (legal).
Raj: dev plan — chunk work: api+model changes, billing estimator job, ui. estimate: 3w backend + 2w frontend + 1w stabilization. can we trim?
Emma: product asks for MVP in 4 weeks. propose reduce to: no billing estimator in MVP; show approximate storage band (low/med/high) and add exact estimator in follow-up.
Steph: fine with banding if we store precomputed bands per tenant. low lift.
Linda: ops gating: storage caps need enforcement in Dedicated and Private. create migration job to enforce at rollout.
deploy-bot: canary plan queued: feature-flag "tenant_retention_v1" -> rollout groups: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%; auto-rollback window: 30m if error rate spike > 2x baseline.
Emma: next steps: Omar mock sharable by 6pm; Raj to post API contract by tomorrow morning; Linda to add ops runbook; Steph to add metric definitions; PRD edit I'll push now. If all good, locking scope at 3pm sync.
Raj: I'll post a small API proto:
```json
{
  "endpoint": "/v1/tenants/{id}/retention",
  "method": "PATCH",
  "body": { "retention_days": 30, "sampling_rules": [{ "id": "r1", "match": "service:auth", "pct": 5 }] }
}
```
Emma: thanks. quick poll: ship with admin override? :ballot_box_with_check:
Omar: +1 (admin override with audit)
Linda: +1
Steph: +1
Emma: locking scope then. I'll convert PRD to final and file for review. thanks team :tada:
